accessibleName.description: Defines the accessible ARIA name of the component.

accessibleNameRef.description:
Receives id(or many ids) of the elements that label the component.

**Note:** Available since [v1.15.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v1.15.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

disabled.description:
Defines whether the component is disabled.

**Note:** A disabled component is completely noninteractive.

max.description: The number of displayed rating symbols.

onChange.description:
The event is fired when the value changes.

| cancelable | bubbles |
| :--------: | :-----: |
| ❌|✅|

ratedIcon.description:
Defines the icon to be displayed for the selected (filled) rating symbol.

**Note:** Available since [v2.20](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.20) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

readonly.description:
Defines whether the component is read-only.

**Note:** A read-only component is not editable,
but still provides visual feedback upon user interaction.

required.description:
Defines whether the component is required.

**Note:** Available since [v1.15.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v1.15.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

size.description:
Defines the size of the component.

**Note:** Available since [v2.6.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.6.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.

tooltip.description:
Defines the tooltip of the component.

**Note:** Available since [v1.19.0](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v1.19.0) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

unratedIcon.description:
Defines the icon to be displayed for the unselected (empty) rating symbol.

**Note:** Available since [v2.20](https://github.com/UI5/webcomponents/releases/tag/v2.20) of **@ui5/webcomponents**.

value.description:
The indicated value of the rating.

**Note:** If you set a number which is not round, it would be shown as follows:

- 1.0 - 1.2 -> 1
- 1.3 - 1.7 -> 1.5
- 1.8 - 1.9 -> 2

waitForDefine.description:
Defines whether the component should wait for the underlying custom element of the web component to be defined. This can be useful, for example, for using instance methods when mounting the component.

__Note:__ This adds a rendering cycle to your component.
